FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 204
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Coleman-Madison
Analyst: Michael Russo Date: 02/10/2026
Senate Bill 204 as introduced allows for local governments to create local land bank authorities,
which would be allowed to acquire certain tax-delinquent properties. This could decrease fee
collections and tax receipts to state and local entities by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the amount of property acquired by the authority, which would be tax exempt. This could
also decrease receipts to various funds by an undetermined amount by exempting all real
property owned by a local land bank authority from payment of license fees, recording fees,
stormwater fees, and municipal assessments.
In addition, this bill could decrease receipts to local governments by an undetermined amount by
requiring up to 75% of the ad valorem taxes collected on real property owned by local land bank
authorities to be remitted to the respective land bank authority.
This bill would also authorize the Governor to create a local land bank during a state of
emergency caused by a natural disaster.
